intervals.note: Greybook records one "Completed" row from approval (15 February 1979) to 14 February 1989 and no separate Data Taking row, so neither a first-data nor a last-data date is stated. The start is the year of the first SppS collisions (summer 1981, CERN Archives guide for UA1); the end is the start of the Finished status. UA5 data at 900 GeV were published in 1986.

name: UA5
notes: No UA5 website exists. Greybook gives no institute list for UA5.

summary.plain: The first-generation streamer-chamber experiment at CERN's proton-antiproton collider (SppS), approved in February 1979 and led by John Rushbrooke. It surveyed how many particles proton-antiproton collisions produce at 200, 540 and 900 GeV, finding that the multiplicity distributions violate scaling.
summary.technical: UA5 at the CERN SppS (LSS4): 'Investigation of ppbar events at 540 GeV c.m. energy with a streamer chamber detection system' (Greybook); approved 15 February 1979; spokesperson J. Rushbrooke, contact person C. Booth; results at 200, 540 and 900 GeV including scaling violations in multiplicity distributions (Phys. Lett. B 167 (1986) 476) and a general study of p̄p physics at 546 GeV (Phys. Rep. 154 (1987) 247).
